{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts undershoot current prices when prices are declining, requiring downward adjustment of initial forecast values",
    "When prices have been stable, model mean-reversion causes initial forecasts to be too low, adding base level bias",
    "Sentiment positivity above 0.5 correlates with slightly higher forecasts than model would predict, reflecting momentum lag",
    "Pricing volatility increases when sentiment turns negative, causing true outcomes to diverge more from forecasts",
    "The gap between forecasts and outcomes grows at 1-2 day lags as market incorporates newly available information",
    "When history shows a clear directional trend, reduce forecast magnitude by 20-30% to avoid overshooting",
    "Sentiment extreme values (above 0.75 or below -0.25) indicate momentum that model momentum term hasn't fully captured yet"
] }
